about: Cancel a residence permit, which also cancels the linked Emirates ID.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: For family members, retirees, property owners, students and employees
Domestic worker cancellations go through MOHRE or the Domestic Work Bundle
Grace period after cancellation: 30 days for most, 60 with a guarantor, 90 for skilled workers and property owners, 180 for Golden, Green and Blue holders
documents: For investors or partners: licence cancellation or waiver certificate
Death certificate, certified, where it applies
fees: Application fee 50 AED and smart service fee 100 AED
Guarantee fee 5,000 AED when a sponsor cancels without cancelling family permits
Fine 50 AED a day after the grace period
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
